premises.text: Pregnancy complications are on the rise and cost the healthcare system billions annually
premises.evidence_span: pregnancy complications have been on the rise. Diseases such as gestational diabetes, preeclampsia, and preterm birth are global epidemics that not only cost our healthcare system billions of dollars annually

premises.text: Expecting moms have many questions and limited peace of mind during prenatal checkups
premises.evidence_span: the only time there's any sort of peace of mind is during their prenatal checkups

premises.text: Current prenatal technology is outdated and limits the information available to moms
premises.evidence_span: inconvenient, expensive, and ultimately limited by 50-year-old antiquated technology

premises.text: Wearable devices combined with data analytics can improve prenatal care
premises.evidence_span: we're designing the future of prenatal care, with technology designed to improve the health of moms and babies

premises.text: The Bloom Life sensor can measure important health parameters of mom and baby
premises.evidence_span: our amazing, lightweight, medical-grade sensor can measure the most important health parameters of mom and baby from conception to birth

premises.text: Existing solutions do not track the health of the mom and are not safe for continuous use
premises.evidence_span: Existing solutions don't track anything about the health of the mom and are neither safe nor convenient for continuous use

premises.text: Bloom Life aims to become standard of care and fully reimbursed by insurance
premises.evidence_span: Our goal is for Bloom Life to become standard of care, fully reimbursed, and utilized by doctors all over to better track and manage the health of their moms

premises.text: Crowdsourcing data from moms can create a comprehensive dataset on maternal and fetal health
premises.evidence_span: we have an opportunity to crowdsource the largest and most comprehensive data set on maternal and fetal health ever collected

value.text: Bloom Life provides expecting moms with accurate and reliable information about their health and their baby's health
value.evidence_span: takes the guesswork out of pregnancy and puts need-to-know information about her body and her baby at her fingertips

notes: Clinical studies and beta user feedback are excluded as traction.
